SMP Lifesteal

Lifesteal core for SMP progression; public listing advertises Folia support.

SMP

  • Lifesteal
  • Progression
  • Folia
View on BuiltByBit

What it does

SMP Lifesteal is a lifesteal core for SMP progression, with tags lifesteal, progression and Folia. Lifesteal is a single, well-understood mechanic — health recovered through combat — attached to a progression loop, so it rewards practice rather than standing still. The Folia tag records the runtime support claimed in the public listing. ArkFlame groups it under SMP with the other combat and progression entries.
